caption: The drawing shows a single female figure rendered in color, positioned at an angle as if leaning or being pulled backward with her head tilted up and slightly to the left. She is depicted with light skin and long brown hair, which is styled back and over one shoulder. Her facial features are detailed and she has a neutral or slightly upward-looking expression. She is wearing a long, flowing dress with full sleeves gathered at the elbows, colored in shades of grayish blue, brown, and streaks of reddish-pink and green. The dress has puffed shoulders, a belt with a circular clasp at the waist, and a wide rounded neckline with layered colored sections and a golden yellow decorative element at the center of her chest. One hand is held to her upper chest, while the other arm falls to her side. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present in the composition.
